title: hymenophyllum myriocarpum var. endiviifolium
intro: Hymenophyllum myriocarpum var. endiviifolium, commonly known as the fern-leaved maidenhair, is a fern species native to Australia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hymenophyllum myriocarpum var. endiviifolium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to soothe coughs, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of various respiratory conditions.
